name: Agentic Finance Index
description: A free register of agentic-finance deployments and infrastructure, by layer and status, and of the mandates agents run under (Open Mandate). Nobody pays to be listed. Status labels follow the Agentic Finance Report's convention: in production, standards live, forward-looking. 'source' says where each status comes from; 'confirmed_by_operator' records whether the operator has confirmed the entry.

entries.name: AMINA Bank
entries.what: FINMA-regulated custody, settlement and fiat rails anchoring autonomous execution
entries.source: Agentic Finance Report ed. 1.0, chapter 03 and 08

entries.name: Solana
entries.what: Single global state, sub-second finality, stablecoin settlement, x402, payment channels
entries.source: Agentic Finance Report ed. 1.0, chapter 04 and 08

entries.name: TensorX
entries.what: Sovereign inference on EU hardware, zero retention, open-weight models, agent-payable via x402
entries.source: Agentic Finance Report ed. 1.0, chapter 05 and 08

entries.name: ALICE
entries.what: Multi-agent orchestration for capital markets, private deployment, traceable reasoning
entries.source: Agentic Finance Report ed. 1.0, chapter 06 and 08

entries.name: vLEI via Veridian
entries.what: Verifiable organisational identity for agents (vLEI, KERI/ACDC) on public blockchains
entries.status: standards live; Qualified vLEI Issuer accreditation in progress
entries.source: Agentic Finance Report ed. 1.0, chapter 07 and 08

entries.name: Blindsight
entries.what: Runtime check that an agent's proposed action matches what its principal asked for; injection and poisoning detection
entries.status: in production (figures supplied by the operator, not independently verified)
entries.source: Agentic Finance Report ed. 1.0, guest contribution

entries.name: Neo (NFTNeo)
entries.what: Autonomous collector of on-chain generative art under a published mandate: can buy, structurally cannot sell; publishes each decision before acting
entries.status: mandate declared; pre-launch, no acquisition yet
entries.disclosure: Operated by the Index's editor. Listed under the same rules as every other entry.
